* perf(v4): prefix issue paths in place in the object JIT

The object JIT copied an issue's whole path to add one key at every
level, while every other container already unshifts in place. A failing
800-deep recursive chain took ~440 ms; it now takes ~39 ms. Building
paths is still quadratic in depth, with a much smaller constant.

Prefixing in place prefixed a path array twice when two issues shared
it, which the interpreted path already did: a `superRefine` that passed
one array to two `ctx.addIssue` calls got `["tags", "tags", 0]` under
`jitless`, in records and in `zod/mini`. `addIssue` now copies the
path it is given.

* fix(v4): copy a path a check pushes before any receiver prefixes it

Receivers prefix paths in place, so a check that pushed a raw issue with
a path it reuses, such as a module-level constant, had that array grow
on every parse: `["k"]` became `["a", "k"]` and then `["a", "a", "k"]`.
Arrays, records and `zod/mini` already did this, and prefixing in place
in the object JIT extended it to classic objects. The issues a check
adds now get their own path where the schema is stamped on them, which
